proposals.title: Re-attempt TASK-0001 using npm workspaces to eliminate the pnpm resolution blocker
proposals.why_now: TASK-0001 (monorepo bootstrap) has been rejected three times. All three reviews trace to the same root cause: the authoritative validation environment resolves the string 'pnpm' to /workspace/pnpm (a directory), not a package manager binary, so 'corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile' exits 1 and the installation gate cannot be verified. Review-03 explicitly cited the pnpm shim as a MAJOR finding because it fakes install success without validating dependencies. npm is natively available in the authoritative environment; switching the workspace to npm workspaces (npm 7+ 'workspaces' field in root package.json, 'npm install --frozen-lockfile' as the installation gate) eliminates the binary-resolution failure without any new tooling dependency. No production algorithm or DEFINIR decision is involved. This is the absolute prerequisite for every subsequent FASE-1 deliverable: without an accepted scaffold, no lint gate, no boundary gate, no compilation gate, and no test gate can exist.

proposals.title: Write ADR-002 (hash function), ADR-004 (rounding enforcement), ADR-009 (CanonicalEncoder), and ADR-005-transcendental (fixed-point log/exp) before packages/core is touched
proposals.why_now: §15 FASE-1 acceptance states explicitly: 'ADR-009 escrito e o encoder implementado antes de qualquer hash de estado existir.' ADR-002 requires the hash function 'especificada bit a bit em ADR' before any rand() implementation. ADR-004 marks the technical mechanism for enforcing rounding-mode declaration as DEFINIR — it must be resolved in an ADR before divInt() is written. Additionally §5.1 constructs prices in log-space (requiring log and exp), but §13 prohibits Math.log and Math.exp in pure packages; a fourth ADR specifying a fixed-point or lookup-table implementation bit-identical across platforms must be written before packages/world is implemented. Embedding any of these decisions in code before their ADRs means the encodingVersion must be bumped retroactively, invalidating all reference StateHashes in tools/bench. These four documents touch only docs/decisions/ and can be authored in parallel with or immediately after IDEA-001.

proposals.title: Implement packages/core: branded numeric types, positional RNG, division helpers, and CanonicalEncoder
proposals.why_now: packages/core is the sole dependency of every other pure package per §14.5. Without branded Money, Quantity, Price, Rate (bigint nominal), Tick and noise indices (safe-integer number nominal), the type system cannot enforce ADR-003 or ADR-004, and violations accumulate silently. Without the positional rand() implementing ADR-002, packages/world cannot be written. Without CanonicalEncoder implementing ADR-009, no StateHash can be computed and INV-01, INV-17, INV-22 have no foundation. This must follow IDEA-002 because implementing core before the ADRs embeds unrecorded DEFINIR decisions.

proposals.title: tools/replay, tools/bench, minimum Electron UI, and Windows+Linux installers to complete FASE-1 acceptance
proposals.why_now: FASE-1 acceptance requires: tools/replay reporting the first divergent tick, tools/bench with frozen calibration ratios per §18 measurement protocol, a minimum UI (lightweight-charts price chart for one asset, BRL balance, buy/sell market order buttons, pause and 1x time controls), and the permanent non-dismissable §20 disclaimer in Portuguese. The performance baseline must be frozen in FASE-1 — deferring it means the bench gate has no reference for the remainder of the project. Windows NSIS and Linux AppImage installers must also exist in FASE-1 in minimum form because deferred packaging reveals ABI and module-native failures that are not correctable locally once architecture is established (§14.6). INV-29 (Electron security configuration) must be audited and verified programmatically.

repository_assessment.current_state: Repository contains only benchmark scaffolding (spec copy, benchmark history, checkpoint files). No production source code exists: no package.json, no workspace configuration, no packages/ or apps/ or tools/ directories, no ADRs under docs/decisions/, no SPEC_BLOCKERS.md, no CI pipeline. All four checkpoints report internal_commit_count=0 and NO_ACCEPTED_CHANGES. TASK-0001 (monorepo bootstrap) was created in CYCLE-000011 and has been attempted three times; all three reviews rejected the candidate. The root cause of every rejection is that the authoritative validation environment resolves 'pnpm' to /workspace/pnpm (a directory), not the package manager binary, causing 'corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile' to exit 1. The third implementation attempt added a Node-executable pnpm shim that fakes install success without actually installing or validating dependencies, which review-03 flagged as a MAJOR finding (REVIEW-002) in addition to the BLOCKER (REVIEW-001) on failed installation. The determinism lint gate, dependency-boundary gate, TypeScript configuration, and test suite were all evaluated as PASS in review-03; only the installation and CI gates remain blocked.
repository_assessment.highest_priority_gap: TASK-0001 must be accepted before any FASE-1 criterion can be met. The single root cause blocking acceptance across three attempts is pnpm binary resolution. Switching to npm workspaces (npm 7+ native workspaces field, 'npm install --frozen-lockfile' as the installation gate) eliminates the dependency on a binary that is not resolvable in the authoritative environment, without requiring any new tooling. Until this is resolved, the entire FASE-1 work stack is blocked.

warnings: SYSTEMIC PROCESS FAILURE: After 21 ideation cycles and three implementation-review rounds, the repository has zero accepted commits. Every rejection traces to the same root cause: the authoritative validation environment cannot resolve 'pnpm' as a binary. Prior implementers reported all local commands green but could not reproduce a green result in the authoritative environment. The fix is to switch to npm workspaces so the installation gate runs with a universally available binary. Continuing to attempt TASK-0001 with pnpm-based configuration will produce a fourth rejection for the same reason.

DEFINIR BLOCKER — transcendental functions for price generation: §5.1 constructs prices in log-space requiring log and exp operations, but §13 prohibits Math.log and Math.exp in pure packages. An ADR specifying a fixed-point or lookup-table implementation with bit-identical results across platforms must be written and approved before packages/world can be implemented. This is a prerequisite for IDEA-004 and is not covered by ADR-002, ADR-004, or ADR-009.

DEFINIR BLOCKER — octave parameters and market generator configuration: the number of octaves, periods, and amplitudes for trendLayer and idiosyncraticNoise are DEFINIR per §5.1 and must be fixed in a versioned configuration file before packages/world is implemented. Any post-implementation change to these parameters requires an encodingVersion bump and invalidates all reference StateHashes frozen in tools/bench. This ADR or config decision must precede IDEA-004.

DEFINIR BLOCKER — tools/* dependency edges: §14.5 defines dependency edges for packages/ and apps/ but does not specify allowed imports for tools/replay and tools/bench. Both tools must import from packages to fulfill FASE-1 acceptance items. A SPEC_BLOCKERS.md entry or ADR is required before those tools acquire cross-workspace imports, to avoid silently violating INV-26.
